title: A top-degree covector of ℝⁿ normalised on the standard basis has Euclidean norm 1 and spans Λⁿ(ℝⁿ)
statement:
Let n ∈ ℕ, ℝⁿ = Euclid n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 (i ∈ Fin n) the standard basis, and e = (e₀, …, e_{n−1}). Let δ be an n-covector of ℝⁿ (δ ∈ Covector (Euclid n) n, a continuous alternating n-linear form) with δ(e) = 1. Then:
(a) covectorEuclideanNorm δ = 1. Here covectorEuclideanNorm β = (Σ over strictly increasing I : Fin n → Fin n of β(b_{I(0)}, …, b_{I(n−1)})²)^{1/2}, with b = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ.
(b) Every n-covector α of ℝⁿ satisfies α = α(e)·δ, as continuous alternating maps with pointwise scalar multiplication.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (δ : Covector (Euclid n) n), δ (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = 1 → covectorEuclideanNorm δ = 1 ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid n) n, α = α (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) • δ
